citations.assessment: The midrash expressly gives Berekhiah bar Chelbo in the name of Rava bar Zavda. The Yerushalmi passage lists Chelbo and Ba bar Zavda separately, allowing the reported variant comparison.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

citations.assessment: Heilprin’s named local pointer leads to the expanded Abba article and does not silently replace Rava in the preceding attribution.
The two names are explicitly joined in another report, as Heilprin notes. This nearby pattern does not remove the attested patronym in the ancestral-merit report.
